decisions.statement: A page saying where its folder is reached has that folder linked there.
The folder linked is the folder holding that page.
Only the pages among the paths handed in are weighed.
A body with no key written in it is not loaded.
A path opening with a tilde is read under the home handed in.
A link already pointing where it should is left alone.
A link pointing anywhere else is taken away and made again.
A link is put in place by a rename, so no call finds the path holding nothing.
Something there that is no link is left as it is and said as wrong.
Two paths naming one link place that link once.
A link that could not be placed is said rather than thrown.
What a page says is read off the page rather than off a table kept here.
Nothing here writes inside the repository.
Nothing here says when a link is placed.

definition: the folder a page owns linked where that page says the folder is reached from
